title: Street Eats
description: Food prices in Vietnam vary widely, with street food being the most affordable option, often costing less than $1 per meal. Dining in restaurants can range from 40,000 VND to 250,000 VND per person, depending on the type of establishment. Budget travelers can expect to spend between 400,000 to 800,000 VND per day on meals.

title: Diverse Dining
description: In Vietnam, food and beverage prices vary widely, offering options for different budgets. Local beers can be as cheap as 20,000 VND, while a meal at budget restaurants ranges from $1 to $2 per person. More upscale options, like a Wagyu Beef Pho, can cost around 288,000 VND. Additionally, a McMeal at McDonald's is priced at 118,500 VND, and basic groceries like rice and milk are relatively affordable.
